decisive_items: a swelling in her right cheek associated with severe pain
a diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
a solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass with ill-defined borders
response.rationale: Ectopic lymph node better accounts for the severe pain, diffuse extraoral swelling, and ill-defined borders; lipoma is typically painless and well circumscribed, so these features make lipoma less likely.

rejected.why: Severe pain and ill-defined borders are atypical for lipoma, which is usually painless and well circumscribed.
